narr: Thunderstorms developing in the evening of March 31 resulted in multiple weather hazards. Hail nearly 2 inches in diameter was observed, trees were downed from thunderstorm wind, and flooding occurred from heavy rain rates. Thunderstorms went on to produce tornadoes in Indiana, and later Ohio.
ev: Both lanes of traffic were flooded on Michigan Route 139 in Niles at Lincoln Ave.
lsr: BOTH LANES FLOODED IN NILES, MICHIGAN ON M139 AT LINCOLN.
